text:
Maya Chen: starting an ensemble run to debug the weird long-tail we saw on Friday. config attached inline.
Liam Patel: nice — is this the one that mixes Poisson ramps and periodic spikes?
Maya Chen: yep. key idea: layered QPS ramps + seeded microbursts to exercise kernel handoff.
Sofia Alvarez: can you paste the generator profile? want to check KV warmup windows.
Maya Chen: here — run profile:
```json
{
  "seed": 42,
  "stages": [
    {"type": "ramp", "start_qps": 50, "end_qps": 450, "duration_s": 300},
    {"type": "burst", "pattern": "chorus", "qps": 1200, "duration_s": 15, "repeat": 6},
    {"type": "long_tail", "alpha": 2.5, "duration_s": 600}
  ],
  "kv_warmup_ms": 1200,
  "prefix_cache": true
}
```
Priya Nair: kv_warmup_ms=1200 feels short for cold-starts on the 80B quantized path. we saw cache misses last time at ~2s.
Liam Patel: agreed. also the kernel selection heuristic flips to int8 fallback at ~384 token length — that handoff may be hurting tail.
Maya Chen: that's the hypothesis. this harness will force sequences of 450–600 tokens during bursts to trigger handoff.
Sofia Alvarez: add an explicit warmup window before each burst? otherwise microbursts will get penalized by KV refill.
Maya Chen: good call. I'll add a 30s pre-burst warmup probe that issues low QPS prefixes to prepopulate KV.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: synth-run/tempo-spike-ensemble -> staging at 3344556680 :rocket: 
Priya Nair: when you run, capture per-kernel latency histogram + KV hit ratio over 1s windows.
Maya Chen: will do. also instrument batching heuristics: batch size distribution, wait-for-batch tail fraction.
Liam Patel: if we see higher 99.9 latency only when kernel switches, we can try pinning kernel selection to prefer fp16 for a canary.
Sofia Alvarez: and run apples-to-apples: same model binary, only change runtime flag. otherwise noise kills signal.
Maya Chen: agreed. plan: baseline (current heuristics) -> warmup probe -> pin-fp16 -> pin-int8 -> baseline again. collect 30m each.
Priya Nair: add eval prompts to check quality regression when pinned to fp16. put them in the logs.
Maya Chen: running now. will dump the first perf summary here in ~25m.
Liam Patel: thanks — if tail improves with pre-warmup, we should bake that into default synth profiles.
Sofia Alvarez: yup. also note any change in median token throughput so SLO math isn't surprised.
Maya Chen: update: first 5m looks noisy but kernel handoff spikes visible at ~T+7m and ~T+13m, KV hit ratio dips ~22% during bursts. saving full traces.
Priya Nair: wow 22% is big. can you attach the trace id so I can pull flamegraphs?
Maya Chen: trace-id: tempo-3344556677-0001. uploading after run completes.
Liam Patel: once we have traces we should check if batching wait-for-batch timeout is causing late tokens to get promoted to a fallback kernel.
Sofia Alvarez: also check GPU kernel launch metrics — stalls due to fragmented KV pages show up there.
Maya Chen: noted. all observations will go into the benchmark doc. next: tweak kv_warmup_ms to 2500 and rerun the burst phase only.
Priya Nair: SGTM. thanks Maya.
Maya Chen: thanks all — will post consolidated perf table and a short recommendation (pre-burst warmup + conservative kernel threshold) after full data is in.
